title: Set the master wedding budget
description: Agree a total budget across both families and split by category (venue, catering, decor, attire, jewellery, photography).

title: Open a dedicated wedding savings account
description: Route all wedding spends through one account so tracking planned-vs-actual is clean.

title: Buy wedding / event insurance
description: Cover cancellation, vendor no-show and weather risk for outdoor functions.

title: Shortlist and book the main wedding venue
description: Compare 3-4 venues on capacity, catering policy, parking and availability on the wedding date.

title: Book reception venue / banquet
description: Reserve the reception hall; confirm it can seat the full guest list with a stage.

title: Confirm mandap / stage layout with venue
description: Finalise mandap position, guest flow and green rooms with the venue manager.

title: Finalise caterer and menu tasting
description: Attend a tasting and lock the multi-cuisine menu for the wedding lunch/dinner.

title: Plan pure-vegetarian menu counters
description: Design live counters and a satvik section; confirm no onion/garlic option for elders.

title: Arrange bar and beverage licences
description: Book the bar service and secure temporary liquor permits where required.

title: Book decorator and finalise theme
description: Choose a colour story and floral theme across mandap, entrance and stage.

title: Plan lighting and sound design
description: Ambient lighting for dinner, spotlights for stage, and a clean PA for pheras.

title: Sangeet stage and dance-floor decor
description: Design a vibrant sangeet set with LED backdrop and a dance floor.

title: Book photographer and cinematographer
description: Lock a team for candid + traditional coverage across all functions.

title: Plan pre-wedding photoshoot
description: Scout a location and shoot a pre-wedding film for the invite and website.

title: Share family + ritual shot list
description: Give the photographer a must-have list of family groupings and rituals.

title: Book DJ / live band for sangeet & reception
description: Confirm playlist style, equipment and a backup power plan.

title: Book baraat band / dhol / horse
description: Arrange dhol, brass band and ghodi/car for the groom's procession.

title: Book pandit / priest and confirm muhurat
description: Confirm the wedding muhurat and the full list of rituals with the family priest.

title: Procure pooja samagri and ritual materials
description: Assemble haldi, kumkum, kalash, mangalsutra thread and havan items per the priest's list.

title: Arrange mangalsutra and toe rings
description: Buy or commission the mangalsutra, jodavi (toe rings) and sindoor box.

title: Design and finalise wedding invitation
description: Approve the card design, wording, and the list of functions printed on it.

title: Send digital invite and build wedding website
description: Publish an e-invite with schedule, maps and an RSVP form.

title: Hand-deliver invitations to elders
description: Personally deliver cards and first-invite sweets to close elders and the family deity temple.

title: Compile the master guest list
description: Merge both families' lists, dedupe, and tag each guest by side and function.

title: Arrange guest accommodation & room blocks
description: Block hotel rooms for out-of-town guests and share allocation.

title: Plan guest transport & shuttles
description: Arrange pickups from airport/station and shuttles between hotel and venues.

title: Set up QR check-in & seating plan
description: Generate QR passes and a stage-view seating chart for the reception.

title: Order and pack return gifts
description: Choose curated return gifts by guest tier and pack with name tags.

title: Book bridal lehenga / saree
description: Order the wedding lehenga with enough lead time for stitching and fittings.

title: Bridal trousseau & function outfits
description: Shop outfits for haldi, mehendi, sangeet, reception and post-wedding.

title: Bridal jewellery set
description: Select or commission the bridal necklace, maang tikka, nath, kaleere and bangles.

title: Final bridal outfit fitting & alterations
description: Complete final fitting; pin the fall, blouse and petticoat.

title: Book groom sherwani / suit
description: Order the wedding sherwani and safa; plan the reception suit.

title: Groom function outfits & accessories
description: Kurtas for haldi/mehendi, sangeet outfit, watch, mojari and brooch.

title: Final groom outfit fitting
description: Complete sherwani alteration and try the full look with accessories.

title: Book bridal makeup artist
description: Trial and book the MUA for wedding + reception looks.

title: Bridal skincare & hair regimen
description: Start facials, hair spa and treatments 90 days out for wedding-day glow.

title: Book mehendi artist
description: Book a bridal mehendi artist and a second artist for family/guests.

title: Groom grooming & fitness plan
description: Haircut schedule, beard styling, and a light fitness/diet plan.

title: Plan Roka / Sakharpuda ceremony
description: Fix date, guest list and rituals for the formal engagement blessing.

title: Plan Haldi ceremony
description: Arrange haldi paste, flowers, seating and old clothes; brief the family.

title: Plan Mehendi function
description: Book artists, plan snacks, music and a green-and-yellow decor theme.

title: Plan Sangeet performances
description: Assign family performances, book a choreographer and schedule rehearsals.

title: Dance rehearsals with choreographer
description: Run weekly rehearsals for couple and family sangeet sets.

title: Renew / verify passports
description: Ensure both partners hold passports valid 6+ months past the honeymoon.

title: Apply for honeymoon visa
description: Submit visa applications with itinerary and hotel bookings.

title: Prepare marriage registration documents
description: Gather ID, address proof, photos and witnesses for legal registration.

title: Choose honeymoon destination & dates
description: Pick a destination that fits the season, budget and visa timeline.

title: Book honeymoon flights & hotels
description: Book refundable flights and hotels; add travel insurance.

title: Arrange forex, packing & itinerary
description: Buy travel currency/cards, plan activities and pack for the trip.

title: Pre-wedding medical & dental checkup
description: Routine health and dental checkup for both partners; carry medicines list.

title: Prepare rain / weather contingency
description: Confirm a covered backup space and tenting for outdoor functions.

title: Build a wedding-day emergency kit
description: Safety pins, stain remover, meds, sewing kit, chargers and cash on hand.

title: Schedule vendor final payments
description: List all balance payments due in the final week and assign who pays each.

title: Final confirmation calls to all vendors
description: Reconfirm timing, headcount and deliverables with every vendor 48h out.

title: Assign family point-persons per function
description: Give each function an owner from the family to coordinate on the day.

title: Complete legal marriage registration
description: Register the marriage and collect the certificate.

title: Send thank-you notes to guests & vendors
description: Send personalised thank-you messages and reviews after the events.

title: Name change & document updates
description: Update bank, Aadhaar, passport and workplace records if changing name.

title: Home setup / griha pravesh planning
description: Plan the new home setup and griha pravesh ceremony.

title: Order wedding album & film
description: Curate the shot selection and approve the album and highlight film.

title: Book florist for garlands & car decor
description: Order varmala, gajra, mandap flowers and car decoration.

title: Recce destination wedding site
description: Visit the destination venue, meet local vendors and confirm logistics.

title: Coordinate guest travel to destination
description: Arrange group flights and transfers for the destination wedding party.
